name: ezimage
description: The ultimate effortless multi-platform image uploader for VS Code. Support R2, S3 and more.
author: Kiang (keepwonder)

commands.title: EzImage: Upload Clipboard Image As…
commands.description: Pick the insert format (Markdown / HTML center / HTML figure) for this upload only.

commands.title: EzImage: Pick & Upload Image Files
commands.description: Open a system file dialog to choose one or more images, then upload them to the configured cloud provider.

commands.title: EzImage: Convert Local Image Paths to URLs
commands.description: Find local image references in this Markdown file and upload them to the cloud, replacing the path in-place.

commands.title: EzImage: Convert Local Image Paths in Selection
commands.description: Same as 'Convert Local Image Paths to URLs' but only operates on the current selection.

ezimage.provider.description: Where uploaded images go. Currently only Cloudflare R2 is wired in; AWS S3, Aliyun OSS and Tencent COS are on the roadmap.

ezimage.r2.accountId.description: Cloudflare Account ID. Found in the dashboard sidebar.

ezimage.r2.accessKeyId.description: R2 API token Access Key ID. Create at *R2 → Manage R2 API Tokens → Create API token*.

ezimage.r2.secretAccessKey.description: R2 API token Secret Access Key. Shown once at creation — copy it immediately.

ezimage.r2.bucketName.description: Bucket name. Create one at *R2 → Create bucket* if you don't have one yet.

ezimage.r2.publicUrl.description: Bucket's public distribution URL (e.g. `https://pub-xxxx.r2.dev`). Enable *Public Access* on the bucket.

ezimage.pathTemplate.description: Path template for uploaded objects. Variables: `{yyyy}` `{MM}` `{dd}` `{hh}` `{mm}` `{ss}` `{timestamp}` `{random}` `{name}` `{ext}`.

ezimage.compress.description: Convert images to WebP before upload. Disable if you want pixel-perfect originals or your bucket already handles optimization.

ezimage.maxWidth.description: Max width in pixels. Images wider than this are downscaled before encoding. Set to `0` to keep original size.

ezimage.quality.description: WebP quality (1–100). 80–85 is a good sweet spot for screenshots.

ezimage.autoInstallSharp.description: Prompt to install the sharp native binary on first use. Requires Node.js ≥ 18.17 and `npm` on `PATH`.

ezimage.disableCompressionNotice.description: Suppress the warning when sharp fails to load (e.g. Electron/Node ABI mismatch).

ezimage.insertFormat.description: How the upload appears in your Markdown document. See the README for the full variable list.

ezimage.insertWidth.description: Width attribute for HTML templates. Examples: `65%`, `600px`, `auto`. Empty = omit the attribute.

ezimage.insertAlign.description: Alignment for HTML templates. `none` drops the `<div>` wrapper entirely.

ezimage.insertCustomTemplate.description: Custom insert template used when `ezimage.insertFormat = 'custom'`. Variables: `{url}` `{filename}` `{name}` `{ext}` `{width}` `{align}` `{alt}`.

ezimage.insertIncludeName.description: Use the source filename as the alt text / figcaption. Recommended for SEO and screen readers.

ezimage.localImageUpload.enabled.markdownDescription: Show **EzImage: Convert Local Image Paths to URLs** in the editor context menu. Disabled by default — opt in per workspace or globally. The two settings below (`skipNonExistent`) only take effect when this is enabled. See the [README](https://github.com/keepwonder/ezimage#local-images-to-cloud-urls) for details.

ezimage.localImageUpload.skipNonExistent.markdownDescription:
> ⚠️ Only takes effect when **EzImage › Local Image Upload: Enabled** is `true`.

Silently skip images whose file does not exist on disk (e.g. deleted from disk). Disable to surface them as errors instead.

ezimage.dropUpload.enabled.markdownDescription:
Take over drag-and-drop for image files in Markdown editors. The two settings below (`requireConfirm`, `placeholder`) only take effect when this is enabled.

When on, dropping one or more images into a `.md` file uploads them to the cloud and inserts the URLs in place of the local path. When **off**, drops keep VS Code's native behaviour (the image opens in a new editor tab). Non-image files are always left to the native handler — EzImage will only intercept a drop when **every** dropped file is a supported image.

**Note:** VS Code requires you to **hold `Shift` while dragging** for the drop to land in the editor. Without `Shift` the file opens in a new tab (VS Code's built-in behaviour, not something EzImage controls).

ezimage.dropUpload.requireConfirm.markdownDescription:
> ⚠️ Only takes effect when **EzImage › Drop Upload: Enabled** is `true`.

Pop a confirmation dialog before uploading on drag-and-drop. Disable to skip the prompt and upload immediately (faster, but a misclick triggers a network call).

ezimage.dropUpload.placeholder.markdownDescription:
> ⚠️ Only takes effect when **EzImage › Drop Upload: Enabled** is `true`.

Alt text shown in the placeholder Markdown while an image is being uploaded. The replacement with the real URL happens automatically once the upload completes; if the upload fails, the placeholder is left as a still-valid (local-path) Markdown link rather than erased.

ezimage.language.description: Display language for EzImage prompts, errors and info messages. Settings panel labels themselves always follow VS Code (not this setting).

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run verify && npm run compile
scripts.package: npm run compile && python3 scripts/package-vsix.py --verify ezimage-dev.vsix
